shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && rg -n \"related|featured|prefetch|product\" src app pages components lib --glob '"'!**/*.map'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx app/layout.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "Static prerenders still include|fully static|static cache|per-link prefetch|App Shell" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | tail -60'

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n -A 20 -B 15 "Static prerenders still include|Both functions apply only|fully static route" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md'
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files .next | rg '(product|prefetch)' | head -100 && git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && rg -n 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products' .next/server/app/product* --glob '"'!*.js'"' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -l .next/server/app/product.segments/product && wc -c .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc .next/server/app/product.rsc .next/server/app/product.html && rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products' .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc .next/server/app/product.rsc .next/server/app/product.html | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files .next/server/app | rg 'product|prefetch' | head -50 && rg -l 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case' .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.rsc .next/server/app/product.segments/**/*.rsc || true && rg -o 'Loading related products' .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.rsc | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const b='http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; const hs=[{}, {RSC:'1'}, {RSC:'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1'}, {RSC:'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch':'/_full'}]; Promise.all(hs.map(async h=>{let r=await fetch(b,{headers:h});let s=await r.text();return {h,status:r.status,contentType:r.headers.get('content-type'),length:s.length,related:s.includes('Compact Widget'),fallback:s.includes('Loading related products')}})).then(console.log)\""

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const b='http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; const tree=JSON.stringify(['',{children:['product',{children:['__PAGE__',{}]}]}]); const hs=[{'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'2','Next-Router-State-Tree':tree},{'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'3','Next-Router-State-Tree':tree},{'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Router-State-Tree':tree}]; Promise.all(hs.map(async h=>{let r=await fetch(b,{headers:h});let s=await r.text();return {prefetch:h['Next-Router-Prefetch'],status:r.status,contentType:r.headers.get('content-type'),length:s.length,related:s.includes('Compact Widget'),fallback:s.includes('Loading related products'),body:s.slice(0,180)}})).then(console.log)\""

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const b='http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; const hs=[{'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'2'},{'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'3'},{'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch':'/product/__PAGE__'},{'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch':'/product/__PAGE__','Next-URL':'/'}]; Promise.all(hs.map(async h=>{let r=await fetch(b,{headers:h});let s=await r.text();return {h,status:r.status,len:s.length,related:s.includes('Compact Widget'),fallback:s.includes('Loading related products'),body:s.slice(0,70)}})).then(console.log)\""

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const b='http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; const bases=[['',{children:['product',{children:['__PAGE__',{}]}]},null,'refetch'],['',{children:['product',{children:['__PAGE__',{}]},null,'refetch']}],['',{children:['product',{children:['__PAGE__',{},null,'refetch']}]}]]; Promise.all(bases.map(async(t,i)=>{let r=await fetch(b,{headers:{RSC:'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'2','Next-Router-State-Tree':JSON.stringify(t)}});let s=await r.text();return {i,status:r.status,len:s.length,related:s.includes('Compact Widget'),fallback:s.includes('Loading related products'),body:s.slice(0,100)}})).then(console.log)\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -g '*.js' -g '"'!*.map'"' 'function prefetch\\(|prefetchStage|await prefetch|unstable_prefetch|waitAtPrefetch|prefetch\\(\\)' node_modules/next/dist/server | head -80 && rg -n -g '*.js' -g '"'!*.map'"' 'PPRRuntime|partialPrefetching' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const b='http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; const tree=JSON.stringify(['',{children:['product',{children:['__PAGE__',{}]}]},null,'refetch']); const cases=[{name:'static shell',headers:{RSC:'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch':'/_full'}},{name:'runtime shell',headers:{RSC:'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'3','Next-Router-State-Tree':tree}},{name:'per-link prefetch',headers:{RSC:'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'2','Next-Router-State-Tree':tree}},{name:'navigation',headers:{RSC:'1'}}]; Promise.all(cases.map(async c=>{let r=await fetch(b,{headers:c.headers});let s=await r.text();return {name:c.name,status:r.status,length:s.length,related:s.includes('Compact Widget'),fallback:s.includes('Loading related products')}})).then(console.log)\""
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat -- app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
